resources.string: Choose a video, then tap Start sharing. Open the link in VLC on a device connected to the same LAN or Wi-Fi network.
Tap Start sharing to create a LAN link.
Open the link in VLC on a device connected to the same LAN or Wi-Fi network.
Tap Start sharing to create a new link.
The device disconnected. The server is still available.
The video cannot be read. It may have been deleted or access may have been removed. Choose the video again.
The video size could not be determined. Choose a file downloaded to this device or try again.
No LAN or Wi-Fi network was found. Connect to a network and try again.
The current network address cannot be used. Check your connection and try again.
LAN sharing could not start. Try again.
The link could not be copied. You can select and copy the displayed address.
